d: Russia drops at least 9 3-tonne bombs on Ukraine's Komyshuvakha. Russia resumed its attacks on Ukraine after the brief Oleshky truce brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump expired. Kyiv says that Moscow dropped multiple FAB-3000 bombs on an aid distribution centre in the frontline village of Komyshuvakha. Firstpost looks at how Russia has managed to modernise its giant, Soviet-era FAB-3000 bombs, and turn them into guided smart munitions.
